set.next_deadline: No open round as of November 8, 2026. The full $2,500,000 HOME-ARP rental housing development allocation is committed to Sendero Commons (Sanger) pending HUD review of the amendment (about 45 days) and a later Board funding agreement; the remaining HOME-ARP balance is for supportive services and administration. Funds expire September 30, 2030.
set.cycle_notes: Board approved the HOME-ARP Allocation Plan amendment October 20, 2026 (file 26-0945). Staff report states Sendero Commons holds 100% of the rental housing development allocation; capital would only reopen if that project falls through or funds are otherwise reallocated, in which case requests would go through ComDev or the annual Affordable Housing Development NOFO.
set.prevailing_wage_basis: HUD Notice CPD-21-10 Section VII.D: 24 CFR 92.354 labor standards apply to HOME-ARP activities, so Davis-Bacon applies to rental housing contracts with 12 or more HOME-ARP-assisted units (Sendero Commons is planned at 10 HOME-ARP units).
